# wso2is_identity_provider (Data Source)

Looks up an identity provider (a connection in the Console) by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_identity_provider" "google" {
  name = "Google"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identity provider ID.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `authenticators` (Set of String) Federated authenticator names.
- `default_authenticator` (String) Default federated authenticator name.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether it is the primary identity provider.
